snippet.title: ODDCORE - Official Gameplay Trailer (Upcoming Backrooms Inspired Retro  Arena Shooter)
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2896260/ODDCORE/

https://discord.com/invite/4pwUckApJ7


ODDCORE is a retro roguelike boomer shooter that throw you, a nobody with a gun, into a vast liminal space, a once-thriving theme park with the name Oddcore, was abandoned by a corporation in the early '90s. But the question remains—why? And more unsettlingly, how are you here now? Stuck behind these walls, you are force to go along with the ride. Pick up your weapon and watch your bullets stylistically explode through endless hordes of corrupted entities as you fight your way back to your freedom, or you can become part of ODDCORE's dark twisted legacy..

#backroomgame #liminalspace #fps #retrogaming #arcade #arenashooter #ultrakill #backrooms #roguelike
